Team — quick legal note on structure:
- We can accept a timeboxed elevated rev-share; permanent elevated rate creates long-term margin exposure unless paired with specific performance/commitments. Suggest: 24 months at 40% with a post-term floor of 30%.
- For the marketplace mechanics, contract must state whether the rev-share is treated as an offset to Redwood revenue (preferred) or as a separate payable to AWS (if the latter, we need indemnity language).
- Cap language: I can produce a clause that limits discounted units to a defined maximum and sets pricing on excess units.

I'll draft redline and upload to Drive by 2pm.
